title: ext/v1 extension manifest
description: The uniform contract for all four extension types: agent, tool, hook, connector. Machine-readable form of extension-contract/contract-reference.md; the executable form is runtime/host/contract.py, which additionally enforces the cross-field invariants C4-C7 that JSON Schema cannot express cleanly.

kind.description: One schema, four kinds. `kind` changes which optional blocks are meaningful, never the shape of the contract.

name.description: Stable identity. Renaming is a removal plus a new proposal, not a version bump.

version.description: Semver. A permission expansion is always at least a minor bump and always needs re-approval.

owner.description: The accountable team, not an individual. Used for on-call routing when the kill-switch fires.

type.description: local-inproc is permitted only for zero-permission, zero-egress extensions.

entrypoint.description: module:function. Required for every runtime, including remote-rpc, because the remote worker needs it too.

endpoint.description: Required for remote-rpc: the attested worker pool address.

network.description: There is no `allow`. Egress happens through the host proxy or not at all.

provides.description: resource.action pairs this extension serves. The host's capability index routes calls by these.

requires.description: Capabilities this extension may ask the host to broker via ctx.call. Not declared, not callable.

events.description: Hooks only. A non-hook declaring events is rejected.

permissions.description: REQUESTS, not grants. Default-deny until a matching entry exists in governance/approved-grants.yaml.

scope.description: Non-empty by schema: unscoped (global) authority cannot be requested. `${caller.tenant}` binds the permission to the delegating caller.

impact.description: A manifest may raise an action's impact above the host's floor, never lower it.

justification.description: Required whenever any requested action is on the host's high-impact list.

allow.description: Destination hostnames (globs allowed). Anything else is refused by the egress proxy.

delegated_auth.description: Required whenever egress.allow is non-empty. There are no ambient credentials.

subject.description: end_user means the extension acts as the delegating human, with that human's upstream authority.

secret_ref.description: A pointer into the host secret store. The plaintext never enters extension code.

output_class.description: Must be `untrusted` for anything that reaches outside the host. Drives taint propagation at the gate.

lifecycle.description: Handlers are chosen from a closed set the host can actually call; an extension cannot name arbitrary host code.
